name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 4px focus ring at 7:1 contrast with `prefers-reduced-motion` support. This meets WCAG 2.2 AA for keyboard users while keeping the ring visible on high-contrast displays. The trade-off is a slightly smaller ring on touch devices, but it remains usable and doesn’t rely on color alone. Reduced-motion media queries ensure the ring doesn’t flash or animate, keeping it accessible for users who need stability.

name: Reader
text:
Risk: 4px ring at 7:1 fails users who need *both* high contrast *and* reduced motion—smaller rings disappear on mobile/touch when motion is off.

Better: Use 6px ring at 4.5:1 with `prefers-reduced-motion` override. Settle with user testing on high-contrast, low-motion devices.
